solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Sudden cold weather to continue slowly? That’ll do for flower (10)

blocks.note: a cold snap is a sudden spell of cold weather
to drag on is to continue tediously

annotation.surface: A gardener wonders which bloom can survive a cold snap followed by a long, dragging winter.
annotation.walkthrough: The question mark after the weather half hints that the phrase is to be read as two separate chunks, SNAP and DRAG ON.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain naming by class: the snapdragon (antirrhinum) is a garden bloom whose flowers open like a mouth.

entries.clue: Player who hasn’t practised, one sounding resigned about pace (5-6)

indicatorNotes.about: SIGHER goes about, that is around, TREAD

blocks.note: someone who sighs makes a resigned noise

annotation.surface: An unprepared musician sighs wearily as they pace about.
annotation.walkthrough: "Sounding" is not a homophone signal here; it means making a sound, and the sound is a sigh.
annotation.definitionFit: A sight-reader plays music at first sight, without having practised it.

entries.clue: Risk missing first walk (5)

indicatorNotes.missing first: GAMBLE loses its first letter, G

annotation.surface: Is it risky to skip the first stretch of a walk?
annotation.walkthrough: A short beheading: take the first letter off a synonym of "Risk".
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to amble is to go on foot at an easy pace.

entries.clue: Affair to get aggravated, having many people crammed in van (9)

indicatorNotes.crammed in: Crammed in means packed tightly inside, so MOB is squeezed into RILE
indicatorNotes.having: Having means holding within, so RILE has the crammed MOB inside it

blocks.note: a do is a party or social affair
to rile is to aggravate or annoy

annotation.surface: A party turns sour when too many people are squeezed into a van.
annotation.walkthrough: A Dormobile is a British brand of campervan, a van with a pop-up roof that sleeps people.
annotation.definitionFit: A brand name used for the thing: the Dormobile is a make of camper van, so it stands for van in general.

entries.clue: Strauss heroine’s solo with soaring finale (7)

indicatorNotes.soaring: In a down clue, rising makes END read upwards, DNE

blocks.note: an aria is an operatic solo

annotation.surface: An opera heroine's big solo ends on a soaring note.
annotation.walkthrough: The heroine is from Richard Strauss's opera Ariadne auf Naxos, so an operatic solo fits the scene exactly.
annotation.definitionFit: Ariadne is the title heroine of Strauss's Ariadne auf Naxos.

entries.clue: Completely finished with FBI man given too much to take in? (7)

annotation.definition: given too much to take in

blocks.note: a fed is a US federal agent

annotation.surface: An FBI agent swamped with more information than he can absorb is finished.
annotation.walkthrough: "Take in" reads as absorbing information; the definition means eating.
annotation.definitionFit: Someone overfed has been given more food than they should take in.

entries.clue: Easily distracted person dropping bishop in country (12)

indicatorNotes.in: In places one thing inside another, so B sits inside TERRAIN

blocks.note: terrain = country, as in open country

annotation.surface: A dizzy person lets a bishop fall somewhere in the countryside.
annotation.walkthrough: "Dropping" looks like a verb; it is a noun, an animal dropping, SCAT.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a scatterbrain cannot keep their thoughts in order, just as easily distracted says.

entries.clue: A rich colour’s dispersed, with no large arrangement of shades (11)

indicatorNotes.dispersed: The letters are scattered and rearranged
indicatorNotes.with no large: L (large) is taken out of the fodder

blocks.note: anagram fodder once the L goes: A RICH COLOURS minus L

annotation.surface: A painter's rich colour has spread thin, leaving only an arrangement of shades.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is all painting, and so is the answer: the art-historical term lives in the same studio as the fodder.
annotation.definitionFit: Chiaroscuro is the handling of light and shade in a painting.

entries.clue: Sense of occasion, raising it with former Chinese leadership (6)

indicatorNotes.raising: In a down clue, raising IT makes it read upwards, TI

blocks.note: the Ming dynasty ruled China from 1368 to 1644

annotation.surface: A sense of occasion that lifts old Chinese dynastic ritual.
annotation.walkthrough: "Leadership" is doing the work of dynasty: the Ming emperors were China's rulers.
annotation.definitionFit: Good timing is a sense of when the moment is right.

entries.clue: Old Italian and French sport overview (8)

blocks.note: a scan is a quick look over something

annotation.surface: A survey of Italian and French sport.
annotation.walkthrough: "Old Italian and French" looks like a pair of languages; only "Old Italian" is the definition, and "and French" is ET.
annotation.definitionFit: The Etruscans were a people of ancient Italy.

entries.clue: Sad, skint and close to total economic disaster, initially requiring input from husband (6-7)

indicatorNotes.initially: Take the first letters of total economic disaster
indicatorNotes.requiring input from: Input is something put in, so NEAR needs H inserted into it

blocks.note: skint is British slang for having no money

annotation.surface: Someone broke and on the verge of financial ruin is saved only by a husband's contribution.
annotation.walkthrough: "Sad" sits apart at the front; the long financial story after it is all wordplay.
annotation.definitionFit: Broken-hearted means overwhelmed with sadness.

entries.clue: A command not to keep a daughter waiting (7)

indicatorNotes.not to keep: Not keeping something means letting it go, so one of the two Ds in A BIDDING is dropped

blocks.note: D = daughter, one D is removed

annotation.surface: An order not to leave a daughter hanging about.
annotation.walkthrough: A BIDDING has two Ds together, and dropping one of them leaves the answer.
annotation.definitionFit: To abide is to wait or stay, as in abide with me.

entries.clue: Songbird close, thrill going around area (11)

indicatorNotes.going around: Going around means encircling, so TINGLE wraps around A

annotation.surface: A songbird close by gives a thrill across the neighbourhood.
annotation.walkthrough: "Close" is the adjective near, not the verb shut.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by class: the nightingale is a small bird famed for singing at night.

entries.clue: Source of deal: I put a gloss on filthy place — immoral behaviour (10)

indicatorNotes.Source of: The source of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: to shine something is to put a gloss on it; past tense shone
a pigsty is the byword for filth

annotation.surface: A dodgy dealer confesses to polishing up a squalid venue.
annotation.walkthrough: "Put a gloss on" suggests spin, which fits the dishonest theme, but here it means literally polished.
annotation.definitionFit: Dishonesty is immoral behaviour such as lying or cheating.

entries.clue: Revised reading incorporating live material (9)

indicatorNotes.Revised: READING is rewritten into a new order
indicatorNotes.incorporating: the rearranged letters take BE inside them

blocks.note: to be is to live, exist

annotation.surface: An editor revises a text that includes live footage.
annotation.walkthrough: "Material" looks like the stuff being edited; it is cloth.
annotation.definitionFit: Gabardine or gaberdine is a hard-wearing twill fabric.

entries.clue: I grow faint around love, in a manner of speaking (5)

indicatorNotes.around: Around means surrounding, so DIM wraps around O

blocks.note: to dim is to grow faint

annotation.surface: Someone swoons at the mention of love, speaking figuratively.
annotation.walkthrough: "In a manner of speaking" usually means roughly; here it is the definition, with "in" linking.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: an idiom is a fixed turn of phrase, one particular manner of speaking.

entries.clue: Tiles, perhaps, stopping water coming through? Not at first (7)

annotation.surface: Tiles on a roof, supposedly keeping the rain out.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface and the answer agree on the roof; the trick is that the whole middle phrase is one word, PROOFING.
annotation.definitionFit: Tiles are one kind of roofing material; "perhaps" marks the example.

entries.clue: Trilogy that’s written? Then do fresh trilogy almost completely different (3,4,2,3,5)

annotation.surface: Having written one trilogy, an author is told to write a completely different one.
annotation.walkthrough: The question mark asks for the written trilogy of all trilogies, Tolkien's.
annotation.definitionFit: Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings is usually published as three volumes.

entries.clue: Poet, foremost of ones in English Literature (5)

indicatorNotes.foremost of: Take the first letter of ones
indicatorNotes.in: In places one thing inside another, so O goes inside ELIT

annotation.surface: A poet counted among the leading names in English Literature.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is accurate praise: T S Eliot is a central figure of English literature.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by class: T S Eliot, author of The Waste Land, is one poet among many.

entries.clue: Observe a German female hugging Maximilian upon return (7)

indicatorNotes.hugging: A hug wraps arms around someone, so EINE wraps around XAM
indicatorNotes.upon return: Something on its return comes back the way it went, so MAX reads backwards

blocks.note: eine is the feminine form of German for a
a shortening: Maximilian cut back to its first three letters

annotation.surface: Watch a German woman embrace Maximilian on his return.
annotation.walkthrough: "A German female" is not a woman but a word: German uses eine for a before a feminine noun.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both words mean to look at something closely.

entries.clue: A period with female expert producing change of opinion (5-4)

blocks.note: a bout is a spell or period of activity

annotation.surface: Time spent with a woman expert leads someone to change their mind.
annotation.walkthrough: The pieces simply line up; "period" as BOUT is the one to see.
annotation.definitionFit: An idiom from drill: the command to turn round to face the other way became a word for reversing a view.

entries.clue: Part of meal incorporating a new pastry (6)

indicatorNotes.incorporating: DISH takes A N into its body

blocks.note: a dish is one course or item of a meal

annotation.surface: One course of the meal includes a novel pastry.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface stays at the table, and the answer is on it.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by class: a Danish is a sweet flaky pastry, short for Danish pastry.

entries.clue: Way information will restrict old source of disease (8)

indicatorNotes.will restrict: PATH and GEN close in on O

blocks.note: gen is British slang for information

annotation.surface: Information about how a disease spreads is used to contain it.
annotation.walkthrough: Gen is British informal for information, as in getting the gen on something.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a pathogen is a bacterium, virus or similar agent that gives rise to disease.

entries.clue: Papa, with experience, upset about note (8)

indicatorNotes.upset about: RECEIVE is upset and turned about into ERCEIVE

blocks.note: Papa is P in the NATO alphabet
to receive treatment is to experience it

annotation.surface: Father, from long experience, gets upset over a note.
annotation.walkthrough: "Note" looks like a musical note or a letter; it is the verb, to notice.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to note something is to notice or become aware of it.

entries.clue: Rural workers last to attend soccer club? (7)

blocks.note: Rovers ends the names of many British football clubs, such as Blackburn Rovers

annotation.surface: Farmhands are the last to turn up at the football club.
annotation.walkthrough: The question mark admits Rovers is only one of many possible club names.
annotation.definitionFit: Drovers drive livestock to market, farm workers.

entries.clue: Bandage son with two articles (6)

blocks.note: A and THE, the indefinite and definite articles

annotation.surface: A boy's injury is dressed alongside a couple of other items.
annotation.walkthrough: "Articles" here are grammatical, A and THE.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to swathe is to wrap up in cloth, as a wound is dressed.

entries.clue: Food consumed includes a lot of calamari, causing concern (8)

indicatorNotes.includes: To include is to contain, so DIET holds SQUI within it
indicatorNotes.a lot of: Most of SQUID, all but its last letter

blocks.note: your diet is the food you eat

annotation.surface: A menu with plenty of calamari worries a diner.
annotation.walkthrough: Calamari is the dish; the letters come from the animal, squid, less its tail.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: disquiet is unease, the state of being worried.

entries.clue: Threshold with party poster destroyed (8)

indicatorNotes.destroyed: POSTER is wrecked into a new order

annotation.surface: A party poster is torn down at the entrance.
annotation.walkthrough: The pieces simply join: DO, then the shuffled POSTER.
annotation.definitionFit: A near synonym: the doorstep sits at the entrance of a house, its threshold.

entries.clue: Member upset about worker repeated statement (6)

indicatorNotes.upset: Upset means knocked over, so ARM is turned backwards
indicatorNotes.about: About means surrounding, so the overturned ARM goes around ANT

annotation.surface: A club member angry about an employee keeps saying the same thing.
annotation.walkthrough: "Member" suggests a club; it is a limb, ARM.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a mantra is a word or phrase chanted again and again.

entries.clue: Eg people on track to drain LA after storm (9)

indicatorNotes.after storm: The letters come after a storm has thrown them about

annotation.surface: After a storm, people set to work to drain Los Angeles.
annotation.walkthrough: "People on track" sounds like people doing well; it means passengers on a railway track.
annotation.definitionFit: A trainload of people is those on one train; Eg marks them as one example of a load.

entries.clue: Detective well-informed about a part of service (6)

indicatorNotes.about: About means around, so TEC goes around A

blocks.note: up on a subject = well-informed about it

annotation.surface: A detective well briefed on one part of a church service.
annotation.walkthrough: "Service" suggests a church or a job; it is a tea service, a set of crockery.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a tea service is the set of cups, saucers and pot, and a cup is one part of it.

entries.clue: Awkward royal attire is more than unforgiving? (11)

indicatorNotes.Awkward: The letters are put in an awkward new order

annotation.surface: Is clumsy royal dress worse than unforgivable?
annotation.walkthrough: The definition goes one step beyond unforgiving: not just refusing to forgive, but striking back.
annotation.definitionFit: Retaliatory action repays a wrong, which goes further than merely not forgiving it.

entries.clue: Venice’s source of light a girl in Rome finally elevated (2,11)

indicatorNotes.finally: Finally means at the end, so only the last letter of Rome is used
indicatorNotes.elevated: In a down clue, A MISS IN E is lifted to read upwards

blocks.note: a laser is a light source

annotation.surface: A Venetian light shines on a girl in Rome, raised up high.
annotation.walkthrough: La Serenissima, the Most Serene, is the historic nickname of the Republic of Venice.
annotation.definitionFit: A nickname: the Most Serene was the traditional title of the Venetian Republic.

entries.clue: Arrange lecture about thorax after resistance (11)

indicatorNotes.about: About means around, so ORATE goes around R CHEST
indicatorNotes.after: After means following, so CHEST follows R

blocks.note: to orate is to deliver a speech

annotation.surface: Organise a lecture on the chest, after someone resists.
annotation.walkthrough: "Arrange" is the verb, as in arranging music for an orchestra.
annotation.definitionFit: To orchestrate is to arrange, whether music or events.

entries.clue: Irishman backed article probing continent, showing lack of feeling (11)

indicatorNotes.probing: NAES and THE push into ASIA

blocks.note: Sean is a typical Irish name

annotation.surface: An Irishman backs an article exploring a continent, callously.
annotation.walkthrough: "Lack of feeling" reads as callousness; the answer is the medical numbness.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: the medical state induced before surgery is an absence of sensation.

entries.clue: Elevated country mostly retaining little passion for City worker (11)

indicatorNotes.Elevated: In a down clue, RURA is lifted to read upwards, ARUR
indicatorNotes.retaining: ARUR holds BIT RAGE inside it

annotation.surface: A nation lifting its heads keeps a little passion for a City financier.
annotation.walkthrough: "Country" wants to be a nation; it is the adjective rural. The City is London's financial district.
annotation.definitionFit: An arbitrageur trades on price differences between markets, a City job.

entries.clue: Everyone without exception ignoring cat that’s symbolic (11)

blocks.note: a categorical statement admits no exception

annotation.surface: Everyone, bar none, overlooks a symbolic cat.
annotation.walkthrough: "Without exception" looks like a qualifier on everyone; it is its own synonym, categorical.
annotation.definitionFit: Allegorical means using symbols to convey a hidden meaning.

entries.clue: Quantity of money given to detectives; quantity of money chief of police missed — fortuitous event? (11)

indicatorNotes.given to: Something given to another is added to it, so CID is attached to COIN
indicatorNotes.missed: PENCE goes without its first letter

blocks.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British police detectives
P, the first letter of police, is missed from PENCE

annotation.surface: Money paid to detectives and money the police chief lost go missing together, surely no accident.
annotation.walkthrough: The repeated "quantity of money" gives two different words: COIN and PENCE.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a coincidence is events happening together by chance, not design.

entries.clue: Consequence of Labour: Conservative concealed lineage when engaging Liberal (10)

indicatorNotes.when engaging: To engage is to take in and hold, as gears engage, so HID holds L inside it

annotation.surface: Party politics: Labour, Conservatives and Liberals trading secrets.
annotation.walkthrough: The capital L turns labour into the British Labour Party; it is the labour of giving birth.
annotation.definitionFit: A pun on labour: the labour of giving birth, not the political party, has a baby as its outcome.

entries.clue: Politician in Ireland to specify New York (6,5)

indicatorNotes.in: In places one thing inside another, so MP goes inside EIRE

blocks.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland

annotation.surface: An Irish politician tries to specify New York.
annotation.walkthrough: "New York" is the definition: the Empire State is the nickname of New York State.
annotation.definitionFit: A state nickname: the name comes from George Washington calling New York the seat of a future empire.

entries.clue: Obscure times surrounding tragic king (6)

indicatorNotes.surrounding: Surrounding means enclosing on all sides, so BY encloses LEAR

blocks.note: three by four = three times four

annotation.surface: Dark days close in around a tragic monarch.
annotation.walkthrough: "Times" is multiplication, as in 3 by 4.
annotation.definitionFit: Bleary means dim or blurred, obscure.

entries.clue: On back of allotment drilling a tree, as it happens (4-4)

indicatorNotes.drilling: A drill bores into something, so T is driven inside A LIME

annotation.surface: An allotment holder drills into a tree while it's happening.
annotation.walkthrough: An allotment is a small rented plot for growing vegetables in Britain, which dresses the surface; the letter is just its last one.
annotation.definitionFit: Real-time means as events happen, without delay.

entries.clue: First course, perhaps, with a small amount in energy (3,4)

indicatorNotes.in: In places one thing inside another, so A SOU goes inside PEP

blocks.note: a sou is an old French coin of tiny value

annotation.surface: A starter served with only a tiny portion, energy-wise.
annotation.walkthrough: The sou is a small old French coin, so "not a sou" means nothing at all.
annotation.definitionFit: Pea soup can be served as a starter; "perhaps" marks it as one example.

entries.clue: A British film festival lacking original profusion (9)

blocks.note: the Sundance Film Festival, in Utah

annotation.surface: A British film festival without any original work.
annotation.walkthrough: "Original" looks like a complaint about the films; it is the first letter.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both words mean a great plenty of something.

entries.clue: Bend twice, accommodating large impact of gale on forest (8)

indicatorNotes.accommodating: To accommodate is to give room to, so BOW makes room for L inside it

blocks.note: "Bend" read a second time: to bow is to bend

annotation.surface: Trees bend again and again as a big gale hits the forest.
annotation.walkthrough: "Bend twice" asks for two different words for bend, WIND and BOW.
annotation.definitionFit: Windblow is trees blown down by the wind.

entries.clue: Work to restrict drop of water in marine product (5,3)

indicatorNotes.to restrict: To restrict is to hem in, so TOIL closes around RAIN

blocks.note: rain is water that drops from the sky

annotation.surface: Work to keep out drips in a product from the sea.
annotation.walkthrough: "Drop of water" wants to be a single drip; it is water falling, rain.
annotation.definitionFit: Train oil is oil from whale blubber, a product of the sea.

entries.clue: European city a source of Noilly Prat? (7)

blocks.note: a prat is a fool, a twerp

annotation.surface: Is this city where Noilly Prat vermouth comes from?
annotation.walkthrough: Noilly Prat is a French vermouth, so the brand name must be split: N from Noilly, and prat in its British sense of idiot.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by class: the Belgian port is one of Europe's cities.

entries.clue: Duke enthralled by a good atmosphere in African city (6)

indicatorNotes.enthralled by: D is held captive inside AIR

blocks.note: the air of a place is its atmosphere

annotation.surface: A duke is charmed by the pleasant atmosphere of an African city.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is a travel note, and the answer is the resort itself.
annotation.definitionFit: Agadir is a city on the Atlantic coast of Morocco.

entries.clue: Goes pale recently, partly pointing up return of illness (7)

indicatorNotes.partly: The answer is part of the words goes pale recently
indicatorNotes.pointing up: In a down clue, it reads upwards

annotation.surface: Someone who has turned pale lately shows signs of the illness returning.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface shows the symptom and the answer names the cause, so a solver looks for synonyms of pale and misses the letters in front of them.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a relapse is falling ill again after seeming to recover.

entries.clue: Struggle at sea with fish releasing line (7)

indicatorNotes.releasing: Releasing means letting go, so FLOUNDER lets its L go free

annotation.surface: Fighting a fish at sea until it breaks the line.
annotation.walkthrough: Fish, line, sea: the surface is angling. The removed L is line, a standard abbreviation.
annotation.definitionFit: A ship that founders fills with water and sinks, a struggle at sea it loses.

entries.clue: Very remarkable to hold an opening for cheat in money business (7)

indicatorNotes.to hold: FINE holds AN C inside it

annotation.surface: Remarkable how a cheat finds openings in the money business.
annotation.walkthrough: "An opening for" does double work: AN is kept, and opening takes the first letter of cheat.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: finance is the management of money, the money business.

entries.clue: Choreographer remains before fashionable society (6)

blocks.note: ashes are the remains after burning

annotation.surface: A choreographer's remains are laid out before the smart set.
annotation.walkthrough: Sir Frederick Ashton was the Royal Ballet's founding choreographer.
annotation.definitionFit: Frederick Ashton was a British ballet choreographer.

entries.clue: Opposing forces position North America for revolution (5)

indicatorNotes.for revolution: A revolution is a turning round, so SIT NA is turned back to front

blocks.note: to sit is to position, place

annotation.surface: Opposition forces place North America ripe for revolution.
annotation.walkthrough: "Revolution" fits the opposing forces, but it only means turning the letters round.
annotation.definitionFit: Antis are those opposed to something.

entries.clue: Leave possibly key athletic accessory, abandoning university programme (6,6,5)

indicatorNotes.abandoning: Abandoning means leaving behind, so DISCUS leaves its U behind

blocks.note: a key is a low island, like the Florida Keys

annotation.surface: A student drops out of university and abandons their sports kit.
annotation.walkthrough: Desert Island Discs is a long-running BBC radio programme in which guests choose records to take to a desert island.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the long-running BBC radio show is a programme.

entries.clue: Form of diving youngster observed in South Africa (5)

indicatorNotes.observed in: Something observed in a place is seen inside it, so CUB sits inside SA

blocks.note: a cub is a young animal, or a junior scout

annotation.surface: A kind of diving seen being done by a youngster in South Africa.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is a holiday scene and the answer belongs in it.
annotation.definitionFit: Scuba diving uses a breathing apparatus underwater.

entries.clue: European energy should involve unknown canal, I prophesied (7)

indicatorNotes.should involve: To involve is to wrap up within, so the two Es wrap around Z

blocks.note: the Kiel Canal in northern Germany

annotation.surface: A European energy company foretold it would take over an unknown canal.
annotation.walkthrough: "I" is not a letter to use; it is part of the definition, the prophet speaking in the first person.
annotation.definitionFit: Ezekiel is an Old Testament prophet, so he can say I prophesied.

entries.clue: Careful approach handling electric current? That’s understood (5)

indicatorNotes.handling: Handling means holding in the hands, so TACT holds I inside it

blocks.note: tact is careful handling of people
I is the symbol for current in physics

annotation.surface: Be careful with live wires; that goes without saying.
annotation.walkthrough: "Current" is the physics symbol I, not a flow of anything visible.
annotation.definitionFit: Tacit means understood without being stated.

entries.clue: A record broken by American baseball team back in Florida? (9)

indicatorNotes.broken by: Something broken by an intruder is split open, so US NINE splits A LP apart

blocks.note: an LP is a long-playing record
a baseball team has nine players

annotation.surface: A record set by an American baseball side back in Florida.
annotation.walkthrough: "Florida?" is the definition by example: the state is a peninsula.
annotation.definitionFit: Florida is a peninsula; the question mark flags the example.

entries.clue: Tear? Note flicker in eye during farewell — my death wasn’t what it seemed (3,3,6)

annotation.definition: my death wasn’t what it seemed

indicatorNotes.during: During means in the middle of a span of time, so N WINK comes in the middle of VALE

blocks.note: a wink is a flicker of the eye

annotation.surface: A tearful farewell at a deathbed, with a flicker of the eye showing the dead man is not dead.
annotation.walkthrough: Rip Van Winkle, in Washington Irving's story, slept for twenty years and was presumed dead. RIP also suggests rest in peace.
annotation.definitionFit: Rip Van Winkle vanished for twenty years asleep, so his supposed death was not real.

entries.clue: Immoral sort of game, smuggling dope at end of leave (10)

indicatorNotes.smuggling: Smugglers hide goods inside something, so DEER hides GEN within it
indicatorNotes.end of: The end of a word is its final letter, so leave gives E

annotation.surface: A shady sort of gambler sneaks in drugs as he leaves.
annotation.walkthrough: Both "game" and "dope" pull toward sport and drugs; they are hunted animals and information.
annotation.definitionFit: Degenerate means morally corrupt.
